description: Find and compare mountains with explicit country, elevation, season, difficulty and glacier filters. All filters are hard constraints; never silently relaxed. Returns compact peak summaries, IDs, total and nextOffset. Read get_peak and get_route before recommending a route: peak-level filters can describe different routes.

bbox.description: Exactly [west,south,east,north] in degrees; west > east crosses the antimeridian.

limit.description: Page size, at most 20. Omit for 10. Use nextOffset to request another page.

maxDifficulty.description: 1–2 easy hike, 3 mountain hike, 4 alpine hike/F, 5 PD, 6 AD, 7 D, 8 TD, 9 ED, 10 extreme. Peak-level minimum, not a guarantee for every route.

month.description: Month with a good historical climbing season; not a weather forecast.

offset.description: Start at 0; use nextOffset from the preceding response for subsequent pages.

query.description: Peak name, alias, country, range, or request such as hiking in Austria in July.

name: search_peaks
title: search peaks
